scenarios.name: Reopen customization from the custom panel title

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the Part Tools custom panel target is initially empty
the user opens Customize from Tools
the user adds 2D Sketches to the Part Tools target
a User Commands panel is visible on Tools
the user right-clicks the User Commands panel title
the context menu offers Ribbon Appearance, Show Panels, Customize User Commands, Undock Ribbon, and Docking Positions
the user selects Customize User Commands
the Ribbon customization dialog opens with Part Tools selected
the target list contains 2D Sketches without a pending marker
the user removes 2D Sketches from the target list
the User Commands panel is removed
